test_case.test_name: NVIDIA PCIe Data Link Protocol Error fatal containment
test_case.purpose: After approval, generate one defined protocol violation at one mapped detector, prove uncorrectable-fatal Data Link Protocol Error and the specified containment/reset through persistent/OOB evidence, then restore platform, link, device and data integrity.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA PCIe injector/spec/tool version/checksum and supported matrix
Exact protocol violation command distinct from Bad DLLP and Surprise Down
AER uncorrectable severity/masks/root reporting and approved fatal containment/reset deadlines
Persistent BERT/CPER/SEL/reset-cause/OOB capture, boot/device/data recovery and restoration
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED: no executable procedure exists. Do not force an AER bit or substitute another malformed-packet/link-loss case. After the complete fatal contract and recovery drill are approved, perform a fresh review and allow one event only.
test_case.expected_result: The intended detector records the signed Data Link Protocol Error as uncorrectable fatal, the platform follows exactly the approved link/device/host containment or reset timeline, durable evidence survives loss of in-band access, and recovery restores topology, device, workload and data with no unrelated impact.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while Criteria, violation and fatal policy are absent. Wrong detector/type, missing persistent evidence, unapproved action, boot loop, unrelated impact, device/topology/data loss or incomplete restoration fails or remains BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Dedicated disposable SUT/workload with serial/OOB capture, recovery media and owners present.
Approved violation, detector, fatal action and rehearsed recovery before injection.
One fatal event once; never retry automatically.
Use independent recovery and preserve first-failure evidence before any clear.
expected_evidence: Exact one-shot fatal stimulus with last in-band and independent trace
Fresh detector-specific Data Link Protocol Error plus persistent BERT/CPER/SEL/reset cause
test_case.recovery: Use only the preapproved OOB/serial/boot-media path. Preserve persistent records before clear, escape any boot loop, restore AER/injector/firmware configuration, then validate topology, link, device, workload and data. Do not retry a fatal event.
